title: Mexico Beats Ecuador 2-0, Ends 40-Year World Cup Knockout Drought
detail: Mexico defeated Ecuador 2-0 in the Round of 32 at Estadio Azteca, with goals from Julián Quiñones (22') and Raúl Jiménez (31'), ending a 40-year wait for a World Cup knockout-stage victory dating back to 1986. The win advanced co-host Mexico to the Round of 16, where it was set to face the winner of England vs. DR Congo. The result sparked massive street celebrations across Mexico City, Guadalajara, and Monterrey, with fans setting off fireworks and mariachi bands playing in central plazas.
